title: 第270章 你确定这不是银帕吗第269章 多元化程度堪比阿米利卡
content_zh:
第270章你确定这不是银帕吗？
“我还以为你这几天会一直在家。”
“和家人诀别只会让他们觉得你之后不会再回来，除了徒增伤感外还有什么用处？况且你未免太小看我父王了，以他的资质，外加龙宫的资源，几百年的时间他未必不能突破化神。”
“有道理。”云阳点了点头，“你是有朋友在这里？”
“差不多，走吧。”敖润招了招手，“再晚点就赶不上181路飞舟了。”
“做灵舟？咱们就不能自己飞吗？”
“在城里飞超速会被罚款的。”丢下这句话，敖润便独自朝九龙湾的正门走去。
我特么一个元婴修士还会因为飞超速而罚款……
算了，入乡随俗，入乡随俗吧。
摇了摇头，云阳也快步跟上了敖润。
不过还好，灵舟的乘坐体验还是挺不错的，这里的灵舟的样貌和玄天门的不一样，这里的灵舟样貌更偏向于古代的那种画舫，通体看着像是木制的，船头一个龙头的模样，后面接着蓬船的样式。
其内部则有一名修士位居船头操控灵舟，云阳感知其是个练气修士，而船舱内则有两排贴着船舱的座椅，倒没有像公交车一样有供站着的乘客扶稳的把手。
不过船舱里倒也没有站着的乘客就是了。
船舱里还自带了清洁术，让整个船舱时刻保持的干燥和清洁，除此之外，虽然船舱里的座位以及被坐的七七八八，有不少人，但却并不感觉嘈杂，这并非什么特殊阵法的原因，只是因为灵舟上的乘客都比较安静。
就算有几个拎着个买菜篮子的大姨，他们唠起家常来的声音也不大。
我去，这么有素质的吗？
这里可没有手机这种能吸引人注意力的东西，
“橘子同学，话说咱们这是要去什么地方？”灵舟上，云阳有些好奇的悄声问道。
“……别叫我橘子。”敖润无语的翻了个白眼随后回答道：“一个……比较真诚的地方吧。”
真诚？

……
“咚咙~181号飞舟已到水平路站，需要下灵舟的乘客请尽快下车。”
“走了。”
跟着敖润一起下了灵舟，来到海边一处看似是一楼，但扭头一看是特么三十六楼的地方。
不知道的还以为来到了山城。
但和山城不一样的是，这里稍微远望就能以“登高望远”的姿态俯瞰无尽的大海，要是有点修为，能跳的远点的，甚至能直接跳到城外的海里。
“你说的真诚的地方……就是一处emmm，饭馆？”
“其实主要是喝酒的地方，而这个地方其实是叫‘渔馆’，因为来这里的绝大部分都是靠捕鱼为生的凡人、低阶修士和炼气小妖。”
“诶等等，其他的槽点我就不说了，妖族怎么还凑过来了？让海妖打渔，这有点问题吧？”
敖润给了云阳一个看白痴的眼神，“怎么？你会觉得我们龙族会和小水蛇之间产生共情吗？”
“也有道理。”
云阳点了点头，便伸手推开这家外墙上刻着消音阵法的酒馆。
content_en:
Chapter 270 Are you sure this is not a silver handkerchief?
"I thought you would be at home these days."
"Farewell to your family will only make them think that you will not come back again. What's the use besides adding to the sadness? Besides, you underestimate my father too much. With his qualifications and the resources of the Dragon Palace, he may not be able to break through to the gods in a few hundred years."
"That makes sense." Yunyang nodded, "Do you have friends here?"
"Almost, let's go." Ao Run waved, "If you are later, you won't be able to catch up with Luffy Boat 181."
"Making a spirit boat? Can't we fly by ourselves?"
"You will be fined if you speed in the city." After saying this, Ao Run walked towards the main entrance of Kowloon Bay alone.
I, a Nascent Soul cultivator, would be fined for speeding...
Forget it, when in Rome, do as the Romans do.
Shaking his head, Yunyang quickly followed Ao Run.
But fortunately, the experience of riding the spirit boat is quite good. The appearance of the spirit boat here is different from that of Xuantianmen. The appearance of the spirit boat here is more like the ancient painted boats. The whole body looks like wood, with a dragon head at the front and a canopy style at the back.
Inside, there was a monk at the bow of the boat controlling the spirit boat. Yunyang sensed that he was a Qi-training monk. There were two rows of seats close to the cabin, but there were no handles for standing passengers to hold onto like a bus.
But there were no standing passengers in the cabin.
The cabin also has its own cleaning technology to keep the entire cabin dry and clean at all times. In addition, although there are many people in the seats and people sitting in the cabin, it does not feel noisy. This is not due to any special formation, but because the passengers on the spirit boat are relatively quiet.
Even if there were a few aunties carrying a shopping basket, they would not make too much noise while chatting about home-cooked things.
Let me go, are you so qualified?
There is no such thing as a mobile phone to attract attention here.
"Classmate Orange, where are we going?" Yunyang asked in a curious voice on the spirit boat.
"...Don't call me Orange." Ao Run rolled his eyes speechlessly and then replied: "A... more sincere place."
Sincere?
…
"Dong dong ~ Flying boat No. 181 has arrived at Huixing Road Station. Passengers who need to get off the boat should get off as soon as possible."
"Gone."
Following Ao Run, I got off the spirit boat and came to a place on the beach that seemed to be on the first floor, but when I turned around, I saw that it was the thirty-sixth floor.
Those who didn’t know thought they were in a mountain city.
But what is different from the mountain city is that here you can overlook the endless sea with a "climbing high and looking into the distance" attitude. If you have some cultivation and can jump farther, you can even jump directly into the sea outside the city.
"The place you said is sincere...is a place, emmm, a restaurant?"
"Actually, it's mainly a place for drinking, and this place is actually called the 'Fishing House' because most of the people who come here are mortals, low-level monks and little demons who make a living by fishing."
"Hey, wait a minute, I won't talk about the other flaws. Why are the monsters getting together? Is there something wrong with letting the sea monsters fish?"
Ao Run gave Yunyang an idiot look, "What? Do you think our dragon clan will have empathy with the little water snake?"
"It makes sense."
Yunyang nodded, then reached out and pushed open the tavern with the silencer formation carved on the outer wall.
